title: Asean summit to delay decision on Myanmar's return to key bloc meetings

blocks.text: A decision on whether to readmit Myanmar to key political meetings of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations is not expected to be reached at the regional bloc’s summit in Manila starting Sunday, according to Asean diplomatic sources. Philippine Foreign Affairs Secretary Maria Theresa Lazaro told Kyodo News the previous day that the issue of possibly returning Myanmar’s leaders and ministers to the table will be “entrusted to Singapore,” which takes over as Asean chair next year.
